info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Treasury By Param1-spec
info.description: The Treasury Bank Portfolio Analysis API provides insights into treasury operations by retrieving detailed bank portfolio information based on specified parameters. This API is essential for financial analysts and decision-makers seeking to evaluate and optimize their banking relationships and treasury performance. By utilizing the provided parameters, users can access critical data that supports strategic financial planning and resource allocation. Typical consumers include banking professionals and corporate finance teams aiming to enhance their financial analyses.

get.summary: Fetch Bank Portfolio Analysis by ID
get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific bank portfolio analysis identified by its unique ID. This endpoint provides insights into the financial status and metrics associated with the specified portfolio, allowing for enhanced decision-making and strategic planning.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the bank portfolio analysis for the specified resource RES-100045. It contains parameters necessary for filtering and retrieving the relevant bank portfolio data.

200.description: Successfully retrieved bank portfolio analysis data.

GetTreasuryByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to bank portfolio analysis.

portfolioId.description: The unique identifier for the portfolio.

instrumentId.description: The unique identifier for the financial instrument.

counterpartyId.description: The unique identifier for the counterparty involved in transactions.

notionalAmount.description: An object representing the notional amount associated with the portfolio.

maturityDate.description: The date when the financial instrument will mature.

recordStatus.description: The status of the record (e.g., active, inactive, archived).

version.description: The version number of the record.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the record was last updated.

metadata.description: An object containing additional metadata related to the response.

GetTreasuryByParam1Response_200.description: Response schema for the bank portfolio analysis API.

amount.description: The numerical value of the notional amount.

currency.description: The currency code for the notional amount (e.g., USD, EUR).

NotionalAmount.description: Represents the notional amount in a specific currency.

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the API response.

correlationId.description: The identifier used to correlate a request and response.
